nodes.label: 亚盘优先于欧指
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 矛盾时以亚盘为准：升盘 + 高水是阻上，降盘 + 低水是诱买。（2784765 场历史提案中的固定百分比权重留作历史对照，不执行；现行主线是倍率时序与双盘比较。）

nodes.label: 数据不完整时信心度降级
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.norm_label: 数据不完整时信心度降级
nodes.rationale: 国际赛事/低级别联赛赔率数据不完整时，可依赖基本面 + 交锋往绩 + 泊松模型，但信心度降级并标注「数据不完整」风险；不用于训练核心赔率分析框架。

nodes.label: 平局识别模式
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 交锋平局多 + 大小球大率低 + 亚盘超低水诱上 = 平局高概率。

nodes.label: 状态数据陷阱
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 近期状态需结合对手质量分析，升班马/弱队的高胜率可能来自更弱对手。

nodes.label: 基本面分析 8 维度强制规则
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.norm_label: 基本面分析 8 维度强制规则
nodes.rationale: 8 个维度缺一不可：完整基本面才能准确判断市场倾向、识别庄家意图、避免单一维度误判（如只看排名忽略交锋）。省略 = 误判风险↑。

nodes.label: 交锋往绩
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 交锋往绩碾压时权重高于排名和近期状态；不迷信排名和主场，战术克制权重更高。

nodes.label: 盘口分类体系
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 分为实盘（盘口与实力匹配）与错盘（庄家有意为之，含诱导/阻挡意图）；错盘再分深盘、浅盘、缺口盘、强让盘、名气盘、生死盘。体系针对亚盘盘口，不是欧指赔率。

nodes.label: 造热形态
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 吸引资金流入某方，诱导多数人买错。只当疑点，须双盘第二路同向；禁止「升盘降水 = 出对面」。

nodes.label: 降热形态
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 减少资金流入某方，阻挡多数人买对；升盘 + 降水为降赔付（真实看好），最可靠。

nodes.label: 主场优势量化
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 原英冠主场胜率>45% 加 10%、客场胜率<45% 减 10% 留作历史对照；现行核实可比样本，不机械加减。

nodes.label: 伤停评估体系
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 中锋缺阵 -30%、后腰红牌 -20% 等非本次验证后的通用系数；现行分析核实具体位置、首发与替补、来源及时点，不按身份机械扣分。

nodes.label: 早盘 vs 临场变动
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.norm_label: 早盘 vs 临场变动
nodes.rationale: 早盘升水是试探市场（可能是诱），临场升水是应对资金（可能是阻）。

nodes.label: 诱买形态识别
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 欧指降某方向但亚盘不升盘/不降水或反向变动 + 水位异常 = 诱买，须警惕反向结果。

nodes.label: 市场倾向判断
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 大众会根据完整基本面下注，不知道市场倾向就无法判断造热/降热。

nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 每次回答、思考、分析、推演，先调用 MCP query_graph(question=...) 检索当场疑难。

nodes.label: 泊松模型
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 未充分考虑伤停的非线性影响（伤停多不等于进攻弱，可能被迫保守）；需纳入 xG 数据和伤停的非线性影响。无赔率修正时仍保持高精度（002 场 Top2 命中，预期总进球 2.82 vs 实际 3 球），但需标注「数据不完整」风险。

nodes.label: 推荐列表过滤规则
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.rationale: 21:00 时推荐继续分析场次，列出了 001/002/003 等已完场比赛；未过滤已完场的比赛，导致无效推荐。展示可分析场次前必须先检查每场开球时间，只展示「未开赛 + 购彩截止前」的场次。

nodes.label: 浅盘三形态与浅盘阻上/诱上
nodes.community_name: IngestSpider
nodes.norm_label: 浅盘三形态与浅盘阻上/诱上
nodes.rationale: 浅盘三种形态：开盘偏浅（后期修正）、浅上加浅（高级别打低级别）、浅盘阻上。浅盘 + 高水（>1.00）= 阻上，上盘赢；浅盘 + 低水（<0.85）= 诱上，上盘不胜。基本面碾压 + 亚盘浅开 = 冷门信号。

nodes.label: Anti-Anchoring 动态形态学铁律
nodes.community_name: Page 40: Table IV: Bettor Performance as a Function of Cumulative Win Percentage
nodes.rationale: 深盘与浅盘尺度差异巨大（深盘 0.20 是剧烈暴跌，浅盘 0.20 是微弱噪音），硬编码数值死尺子会误判，须以 Winkelmann/Goto/Constantinou 学术形态学为通用准绳并依据终盘是否回踩初盘基准（t_end ≤ t_0）定性。

nodes.label: Anti-Binary-Veto 永久戒除一票否决铁律
nodes.community_name: Page 40: Table IV: Bettor Performance as a Function of Cumulative Win Percentage
nodes.norm_label: anti-binary-veto 永久戒除一票否决铁律
nodes.rationale: 足球是高维连续概率场，升水/退盘/跳档只是做市商筹码天平倾斜的连续信号，绝非直接判死刑的机械开关，必须依托大局观、物理底牌与 Minimax 净赔付动态评估。

nodes.label: Anti-Code-Deflection 推演失误不甩锅代码铁律
nodes.community_name: Page 40: Table IV: Bettor Performance as a Function of Cumulative Win Percentage
nodes.norm_label: anti-code-deflection 推演失误不甩锅代码铁律
nodes.rationale: 代码管道只是数据质检员与搬运工；数据无物理损坏时失利源于模型博弈认知缺陷、诱盘误判或双盘矛盾，改代码只是逃避认知失败的虚假安全感。

nodes.label: 庄家净赔付乘积真理（Anti-Low-Odds-Fallacy）
nodes.community_name: Page 40: Table IV: Bettor Performance as a Function of Cumulative Win Percentage
nodes.rationale: 净赔付_i = V·(O_i·w_i − 1)，决定净损失的是赔率与筹码集中度之积；最低赔率在 w=90% 大众扎堆时会穿仓（大热必死），高赔冷门因筹码真空才是做市商净赔付最小化与收割的落脚点，故严禁把低赔等同于防守。

nodes.label: Human Brief Gates (Anti-Ad / Anti-Collapse / Anti-Placeholder / Anti-Omission / Initial Odds / Anti-Timeline / Anti-Truncation)
nodes.norm_label: human brief gates (anti-ad / anti-collapse / anti-placeholder / anti-omission / initial odds / anti-timeline / anti-truncation)
nodes.rationale: The last two gates protect the analysis stage: the brief mirrors source order; only the downstream reader sorts by timestamp ascending. The .md brief is a view, not a source of truth — the .db remains the only machine input.

nodes.label: ETLX CLI 1.156.2 (etlx-windows-linking-amd64.exe)
nodes.rationale: A single empty working DB is built and ETLX reads the JSONL directly: there is no schema.sql, staging table, view, second database, or Python cleanup after ETLX. A failed build leaves data/.build/build.db for inspection and does not touch the old final DB.

nodes.label: GATE_FINAL (table/row/integrity assertions)
nodes.rationale: Promotion happens only after the gate; an endpoint failure blocks promotion and must not be converted into [官方未开盘]. ETLX's 'Error loading .env file' is non-fatal only when exit 0 and the SQLite gates pass — the database check is authoritative.

nodes.label: JSONL Row Contract (one row per endpoint)
nodes.norm_label: jsonl row contract (one row per endpoint)
nodes.rationale: The JSONL is written outside the repository and deleted after successful promotion; a short JSONL, a missing key, or a mismatched hash blocks promotion.

nodes.label: 22-Bookmaker Roster (21 Euro slots / 7 AH-OU slots)
nodes.rationale: Missing bookmakers are a capture omission; the only legal empty state is an official no-offering written as [官方未开盘], never an invented row.

nodes.label: 亚盘 (Asian handicap)
nodes.rationale: When one company has multiple records with the same opening line, the three opening columns come from the earliest record, the three latest columns from the latest record, and 更新时间 from the latest timestamp. Never take the whole latest row, because that mislabels a later reopening as the opening line.

nodes.label: 大小球 (Over/under)
nodes.rationale: When one company has multiple records with the same opening line, the three opening columns come from the earliest record, the three latest columns from the latest record, and 更新时间 from the latest timestamp. Never take the whole latest row, because that mislabels a later reopening as the opening line.

nodes.label: 球队基本情况 (team info, 14 fixed columns)
nodes.norm_label: 球队基本情况 (team info, 14 fixed columns)
nodes.rationale: Primary key is 比赛ID + 数据类型 + 队伍 + 身份 + 姓名 + 号码; match-info rows use an empty string for 号码 while lineup and injury rows use the real number. Row order is match info, home starters, away starters, home bench, away bench, home injuries, away injuries; lineups are optional but injuries remain required.

nodes.label: 27 Endpoint Keys from 26 Requests
